results.name: N14-linked-replacement-receipt-withheld
results.why: R14/R3/R12: the wallet replaces X (same account, nonce, call); the payer links the replacement; the provider then reports it included but withholds its receipt. Uncertainty must stay uncertainty (no success, no retry); the status should say verification is incomplete rather than that an unidentified transaction used the nonce (#665 comment 7196313386)
